indicators.label: Population of Israelis
indicators.description: CBS table 2.11 Population of Israelis under the source's statistical coverage.
indicators.method: CBS table 2.11 district count, published in thousands rounded to one decimal and converted to persons.
indicators.temporal_coverage: CBS reference years 1948, 1961, 1972, 1983, 1995, 2008, 2022, and 2024; 1948 construct values are null recorded context.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Six CBS districts plus the separately labelled Judea and Samaria Area under CBS statistical coverage.
indicators.quality_notes: The 1948 district sum is 17.1 thousand below the national total; the source remainder is reported and never distributed.

indicators.label: Classified in a religion group (count)
indicators.description: Legacy area-summary field used for the Population Register count classified as Jewish, Muslim, Christian, or Druze; it is never a belief or practice measure.
indicators.method: Sum of the CBS table 2.11 Jewish, Muslim, Christian, and Druze district entries; no national residual is distributed.
indicators.temporal_coverage: CBS reference years 1948, 1961, 1972, 1983, 1995, 2008, 2022, and 2024; 1948 construct values are null recorded context.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Six CBS districts plus the separately labelled Judea and Samaria Area under CBS statistical coverage.
indicators.quality_notes: District values sum the Jewish, Muslim, Christian, and Druze entries CBS publishes. Small group totals outside published district entries remain national reconciliation residuals and are never distributed. Counts are published in thousands rounded to one decimal.

indicators.label: Classified in a religion group (%) — Population Register classification, not belief or practice
indicators.description: Share of the CBS table 2.11 district population classified in a recognised religion group: Jewish, Muslim, Christian, or Druze. This is Population Register classification, not belief or practice.
indicators.method: 100 times the published district sum for Jewish, Muslim, Christian, and Druze divided by the published district total.
indicators.temporal_coverage: CBS reference years 1948, 1961, 1972, 1983, 1995, 2008, 2022, and 2024; 1948 construct values are null recorded context.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Six CBS districts plus the separately labelled Judea and Samaria Area under CBS statistical coverage.
indicators.quality_notes: District values sum the Jewish, Muslim, Christian, and Druze entries CBS publishes. Small group totals outside published district entries remain national reconciliation residuals and are never distributed. Counts are published in thousands rounded to one decimal.

indicators.label: Not classified by religion (count)
indicators.description: Legacy no_religion field used for CBS's category verbatim: Not classified by religion. This is a Population Register classification for residents without a recognised religious classification (notably many immigrants and their descendants not registered in a religion group); it is not a measure of no religion, irreligion, or secularity.
indicators.method: CBS table 2.11 Not classified by religion district entry; no relabelling or imputation.
indicators.temporal_coverage: CBS reference years 1948, 1961, 1972, 1983, 1995, 2008, 2022, and 2024; 1948 construct values are null recorded context.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Six CBS districts plus the separately labelled Judea and Samaria Area under CBS statistical coverage.
indicators.quality_notes: This is a Population Register classification for residents without a recognised religious classification (notably many immigrants and their descendants not registered in a religion group); it is not a measure of no religion, irreligion, or secularity. CBS publishes this category by district for 1995, 2008, 2022, and 2024; earlier values are null. Counts are published in thousands rounded to one decimal.

indicators.label: Not classified by religion (%)
indicators.description: CBS's category verbatim: Not classified by religion (%). This is a Population Register classification for residents without a recognised religious classification (notably many immigrants and their descendants not registered in a religion group); it is not a measure of no religion, irreligion, or secularity.
indicators.method: 100 times the CBS table 2.11 Not classified by religion district entry divided by the published district total.
indicators.temporal_coverage: CBS reference years 1948, 1961, 1972, 1983, 1995, 2008, 2022, and 2024; 1948 construct values are null recorded context.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Six CBS districts plus the separately labelled Judea and Samaria Area under CBS statistical coverage.
indicators.quality_notes: This is a Population Register classification for residents without a recognised religious classification (notably many immigrants and their descendants not registered in a religion group); it is not a measure of no religion, irreligion, or secularity. CBS publishes this category by district for 1995, 2008, 2022, and 2024; earlier values are null. Counts are published in thousands rounded to one decimal.

visual_layers.label: Classified in a religion group (%) — Population Register classification, not belief or practice
visual_layers.description: Population Register share classified as Jewish, Muslim, Christian, or Druze.
visual_layers.aggregation_rule: sum published CBS district entries for Jewish, Muslim, Christian, and Druze; distribute no residual
visual_layers.notes: Population Register classification, never belief or practice. The 1948 wave is recorded context with null construct values.

visual_layers.label: Not classified by religion (%)
visual_layers.description: CBS's category verbatim. This is a Population Register classification for residents without a recognised religious classification (notably many immigrants and their descendants not registered in a religion group); it is not a measure of no religion, irreligion, or secularity.
visual_layers.aggregation_rule: reported CBS district category; no imputation
visual_layers.notes: This is a Population Register classification for residents without a recognised religious classification (notably many immigrants and their descendants not registered in a religion group); it is not a measure of no religion, irreligion, or secularity. Available for 1995, 2008, 2022, and 2024 only.

This is a Population Register classification for residents without a recognised religious classification (notably many immigrants and their descendants not registered in a religion group); it is not a measure of no religion, irreligion, or secularity. These fields report Population Register classification, never belief or practice.
